name: cc_cookie
description: Stores visitor consent preferences and revision status.

name: woocommerce_items_in_cart
description: Helps WooCommerce determine when cart contents and session change.

name: woocommerce_cart_hash
description: Stores a unique cryptographic hash of the cart contents to detect cart modifications.

name: wp_woocommerce_session_*
description: Contains a unique code for each customer to link cart and session data in the database.

name: __cf_bm
description: Cloudflare bot management cookie used to identify and manage malicious automated traffic.

name: cf_clearance
description: Clears visitors who successfully completed a Cloudflare security challenge or Turnstile verification.

name: __stripe_mid
description: Fraud prevention identifier used by Stripe payment processor to detect suspicious card activities.

name: __stripe_sid
description: Fraud prevention session identifier used by Stripe payment gateway.

name: _ga
description: Used by Google Analytics to distinguish unique website visitors.

name: _gid
description: Used by Google Analytics to distinguish users over a 24-hour window.

name: _ga_*
description: Maintains persistent session state and page count for Google Analytics 4.

name: _gat
description: Used to throttle the request rate to Google Analytics servers on high-traffic sites.

name: _gat_*
description: Used to throttle request rate per tracker ID for Google Analytics.

name: _gcl_au
description: Used by Google AdSense and Tag Manager for experimenting with advertisement efficiency across websites.

name: _gcl_aw
description: Conversion-tracking cookie set when a user clicks on a Google Ad.

name: _gcl_dc
description: Google DoubleClick conversion tracking cookie.

name: IDE
description: Used by Google DoubleClick to register and report the user's actions after viewing or clicking ads.

name: _fbp
description: Stores and tracks visits across websites for Meta and Facebook advertising attribution.

name: _fbc
description: Stores the last click identifier (fbclid) when a user arrives from a Facebook ad.

name: fr
description: Primary advertising cookie used by Facebook to deliver, measure, and improve the relevancy of ads.

name: _clck
description: Persists the Clarity user ID and preferences unique to the website across pages.

name: _clsk
description: Connects multiple page views by a user into a single Clarity recording session.

name: _hjSessionUser_*
description: Hotjar cookie that persists the Hotjar User ID unique to this site on the browser.

name: _hjSession_*
description: Holds current session data to ensure subsequent requests in the session window are attributed to the same recording.

name: _hjIncludedInSessionSample_*
description: Determines if the visitor is included in the data sampling defined by the site session limit.

name: _ttp
description: Measures and improves the performance of TikTok advertising campaigns and attributes events.

name: _pin_unauth
description: Used by Pinterest to track the actions of unauthenticated visitors on sites with the Pinterest tag.

name: bcookie
description: Browser Identifier cookie set by LinkedIn to uniquely identify devices accessing LinkedIn services.

name: li_sugr
description: Used by LinkedIn to make a probabilistic match of a user's identity outside the Designated Countries.

name: _ym_uid
description: Used by Yandex Metrica to identify site visitors and compile analytics reports.

name: _ym_d
description: Saves the date of the user's first site session for retention calculation.

name: _pk_id.*
description: Used by Matomo Analytics to store a unique user ID to recognize returning visitors.

name: _pk_ses.*
description: Short-lived session cookie used by Matomo to temporarily store data for the visit.

name: VISITOR_INFO1_LIVE
description: Estimates bandwidth and personalizes video suggestions on pages with embedded YouTube videos.

name: YSC
description: Registers a unique ID to keep statistics of what videos from YouTube the user has seen.

name: vuid
description: Used by Vimeo analytics to collect metrics on video playback interactions.

name: hubspotutk
description: Used by HubSpot CRM to track a visitor's identity and prevent duplicate contact creations.

name: __hssc
description: Keeps track of sessions to determine if HubSpot needs to increment session counts in the reporting.

name: __hssrc
description: Set by HubSpot to determine if the visitor has restarted their browser session.

name: __hstc
description: The main cookie for tracking visitors containing domain, user token, and timestamp.

name: intercom-id-*
description: Allows visitors to maintain chat history and identity across multiple pages via Intercom Messenger.

name: crisp-client/*
description: Restores visitor live chat conversations and settings across browsing sessions.

name: __tawkuuid
description: Uniquely identifies the visitor device to support persistent live chat conversations on Tawk.to.
